name: Create Hyperdrive
description: Create Hyperdrive Creates and returns a new Hyperdrive configuration. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs
Creates and returns a new Hyperdrive configuration. For a PlanetScale integration, the Cloudflare account must already be linked to PlanetScale in the Hyperdrive dashboard.
Required: account_id (path) — The Cloudflare account ID.; body (body)

name: Create Database Signature
description: Create Database Signature Returns a short-lived signed authorization for creating a database that is billed through Cloudflare. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/integrationsOperations/{integration}/createDatabaseSignature
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/integrationsOperations/{integration}/createDatabaseSignature
Returns a short-lived signed authorization for creating a database that is billed through Cloudflare. The caller passes these values to the integration partner's own CLI, which verifies the signature before creating the database. Requires the account to be entitled to Cloudflare-billed databases for the integration.
Required: account_id (path) — The Cloudflare account ID.; integration (path) — The database integration to authorize against. This value is case-insensitive.

name: Delete Hyperdrive
description: Delete Hyperdrive Deletes the specified Hyperdrive. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs/{hyperdrive_id}

name: Get Hyperdrive
description: Get Hyperdrive Returns the specified Hyperdrive configuration. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs/{hyperdrive_id}

name: List Hyperdrives
description: List Hyperdrives Returns a list of Hyperdrives. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs
Returns a list of Hyperdrives.
Required: account_id (path) — The Cloudflare account ID.
Optional: page (query) — Page number of paginated results.; per_page (query) — Maximum number of results per page.

name: Update Hyperdrive
description: Update Hyperdrive Updates and returns the specified fields of the Hyperdrive configuration. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs/{hyperdrive_id}

name: Restart Hyperdrive
description: Restart Hyperdrive Restarts the connection pool for the specified Hyperdrive configuration without changing its configuration. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs/{hyperdrive_id}/restart
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs/{hyperdrive_id}/restart
Restarts the connection pool for the specified Hyperdrive configuration without changing its configuration. Existing connections are drained and a new pool is established at the edge.
Required: account_id (path) — The Cloudflare account ID.; hyperdrive_id (path) — The unique identifier of the Hyperdrive configuration.

name: Replace Hyperdrive
description: Replace Hyperdrive Replaces and returns the specified Hyperdrive configuration. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs/{hyperdrive_id}
